lines.l: Take it from me, all these things ain't for free, but just to do what's right for you and love, love, love, love.
Oh, give me strength. Today's everyday, everyday. Oh, no, give me strength. Today's everyday.
Quake, quake, don't mess around You'll lose yourself before you even get found
Listen, listen, thunder will roam The very best of you make you lose control
Don't stop trying, the hurt will subside in
Time will pull and thought will appear
Don't answer questions, just make God for your blessings
Hold on to the key of truth and love, love, love
You have all the power to decide what's best for you
Don't rely on no one else to show you what to do
I just say, Lord, give me strength to face every day.
You just say, Lord, give me strength to face every day.
